dn27:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
dn27:1.3: tena kho pana samayena vāseṭṭhabhāradvājā bhikkhūsu parivasanti bhikkhubhāvaṃ ākaṅkhamānā.
dn27:1.4: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito pāsādā orohitvā pāsādapacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamati.
dn27:2.1: addasā kho vāseṭṭho bhagavantaṃ sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhitaṃ pāsādā orohitvā pāsādapacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamantaṃ.
dn27:2.3: “ayaṃ āvuso bhāradvāja bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito pāsādā orohitvā pāsādapacchāyāyaṃ abbhokāse caṅkamati.
dn27:2.5: appevanāma labheyyāma bhagavato santikā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savaṇāyā”ti.
dn27:2.7: atha kho vāseṭṭhabhāradvājā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ anucaṅkamiṃsu.
dn27:3.2: ‘tumhe khvattha vāseṭṭhā, brāhmaṇajaccā brāhmaṇakulīnā brāhmaṇakulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā. kacci vo vāseṭṭhā, brāhmaṇā na akkosanti na paribhāsantī?ti.
dn27:3.3: “taggha no bhante, brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti attarūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyā?ti”.
dn27:3.4: “yathā kathaṃ pana vo vāseṭṭhā, brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti attarūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyā?ti”.
dn27:3.7: brāhmaṇo’va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇhā aññe vaṇṇā.
dn27:3.9: brāhmaṇā’va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāyādā.
dn27:3.10: te tumhe seṭṭhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ hitvā hīnamattha vaṇṇaṃ ajjhupagatā, yadidaṃ muṇḍake samaṇake ibbhe kaṇhe bandhupādāpacce.
dn27:3.11: tayidaṃ na sādhu, tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ, yaṃ tumhe seṭṭhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ hitvā hīnamattha vaṇṇaṃ ajjhupagatā, yadidaṃ muṇḍake samaṇake ibbhe kaṇhe bandhupādāpacce”ti.
dn27:3.12: evaṃ kho no bhante brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti attarūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya no aparipuṇṇāyā”ti.
dn27:4.1: “taggha vo vāseṭṭhā brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ asarantā evamāhaṃsu:
dn27:4.2: brāhmaṇo’va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīnā aññe vaṇṇā.
dn27:4.3: brāhmaṇo va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇhā aññe vaṇṇā,
dn27:4.5: brāhmaṇā’va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāyādā”ti.
dn27:4.6: dissanti kho pana vāseṭṭhā brāhmaṇānaṃ brāhmaṇiyo utuniyo’pi gabbhiniyo’pi vijāyamānā’pi pāyamānā’pi.
dn27:4.7: te ca brāhmaṇā yonijā’va samānā evamāhaṃsu:
dn27:4.12: te ca brahmānañceva abbhācikkhanti musā ca bhāsanti bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavanti.
dn27:5.3: khattiyo’pi kho vāseṭṭhā, idhekacco pāṇātipātī hoti adinnādāyī kāmesu micchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhī.
dn27:5.4: iti kho vāseṭṭha, ye’me dhammā akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā sāvajjā sāvajjasaṅkhātā asevitabbā asevitabbasaṅkhātā na alamariyā na alamariyasaṅkhātā, kaṇhā kaṇhavipākā viññugarahitā, khattiye pi te idhekacce sandissanti.
dn27:5.7: suddo pi kho vāseṭṭha idhekacco pāṇātipātī hoti adinnādāyī …pe… micchādiṭṭhī.
dn27:5.8: iti kho vāseṭṭha, ye’ me dhammā akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā …pe…
dn27:6.1: khattiyo pi kho vāseṭṭha, idhekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti. adinnādānā paṭivirato, kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato, musāvādā paṭivirato, pisunāya vācāya paṭivirato, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato, samphappalāpā paṭivirato, anabhijjhālu abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhi.
dn27:6.2: iti kho vāseṭṭhā, ye’ me dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā anavajjā anavajjasaṅkhātā sevitabbā sevitabbasaṅkhātā alamariyā alamariyasaṅkhātā sukkā sukkavipākā viññuppasatthā, khattiye pi te vāseṭṭhā idhekacce sandissanti.
dn27:6.5: suddo pi kho vāseṭṭhā idhekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe…
dn27:6.7: iti kho vāseṭṭhā, ye’me dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā anavajjā anavajjasaṅkhātā sevitabbā sevitabbasaṅkhātā alamariyā alamariyasaṅkhātā sukkā sukkavipākā viññuppasatthā,
dn27:7.1: imesu kho vāseṭṭhā, catusu vaṇṇesu evaṃ ubhayavokiṇṇesu vattamānesu kaṇhasukkesu dhammesu viññugarahitesu ceva viññuppasatthesu ca. yadettha brāhmaṇā evamāhaṃsu:
dn27:7.2: brāhmaṇo’va seṭṭho vaṇṇo hīnā aññe vaṇṇā.
dn27:7.3: brāhmaṇo’va sukko vaṇṇo kaṇhā aññe vaṇṇā,
dn27:7.5: brāhmaṇā’va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāyādā”ti.
dn27:7.8: imesaṃ hi vāseṭṭhā, catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimutto, so nesaṃ aggamakkhāyati. dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:7.9: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca.
dn27:7.10: tadamināpetaṃ vāseṭṭhā, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā dhammova seṭṭho janetasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca.
dn27:8.1: jānāti kho pana vāseṭṭhā, rājā pasenadi kosalo
dn27:8.3: sakyā kho pana vāseṭṭhā, rañño pasenadino kosalassa anantarā anuyuttā bhavanti.
dn27:8.4: karonti kho vāseṭṭhā, sakyā raññe pasenadimhi kosale nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ.
dn27:8.5: iti kho vāseṭṭhā, yaṃ karonti sakyā raññe pasenadimhi kosale nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ, karoti taṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo tathāgate nipaccakāraṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ. nanu ‘sujāto samaṇo gotamo, dujjāto’hamasmi,
dn27:8.9: atha kho naṃ dhammaṃ yeva sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno evaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo tathāgate nipaccakāraṃ karoti abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ.
dn27:8.10: iminā’pi kho etaṃ vāseṭṭhā, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā dhammo’va seṭṭho jane’tasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca.
dn27:9.1: tumhe khvattha vāseṭṭhā nānājaccā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānākulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā.
dn27:9.3: yassa kho panassa vāseṭṭhā, tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā daḷhā asaṃhāriyā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ, tassetaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya:
dn27:9.4: bhagavato’mhi putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādo’ti.
dn27:9.6: tathāgatassa hetaṃ vāseṭṭhā adhivacanaṃ dhammakāyo iti pi, brahmakāyo iti pi, dhammabhūto iti pi, brahmabhūto iti pi.
dn27:10.1: hoti kho so vāseṭṭhā, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati.
dn27:10.2: saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarasaṃvattanikā honti.
dn27:10.3: te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayampabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn27:10.4: hoti kho so vāseṭṭhā, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko vivaṭṭati.
dn27:10.5: vivaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchanti.
dn27:10.6: te’dha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayampabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino, ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti. rasapaṭhavipātubhāvo
dn27:11.1: ekodakībhūtaṃ kho pana vāseṭṭhā, tena samayena hoti andhakāro andhakāratimisā.
dn27:11.2: na candimasuriyā paññāyanti, na nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni paññāyanti, na rattindivā paññāyanti, na māsaddhamāsā paññāyanti, na utusaṃvaccharā paññāyanti, na itthipumā paññāyanti. sattā sattātveva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti.
dn27:11.3: atha kho tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā sattānaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena rasā paṭhavī udakasmiṃ samatāni
dn27:11.4: seyyathāpi nāma payaso tattassa nibbāyamānassa upari santānakaṃ hoti,
dn27:11.6: sā ahosi vaṇṇasampannā gandhasampannā rasasampannā. seyyathāpi nāma sampannaṃ vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ, evaṃvaṇṇā ahosi,
dn27:11.9: atha kho vāseṭṭhā, aññataro satto lolajātiko,
dn27:11.10: ‘ambho kimevidaṃ bhavissatī’ti rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyi.
dn27:11.11: tassa rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyato acchādesi, taṇhā cassa okkami.
dn27:11.12: aññe’pi kho vāseṭṭhā sattā tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamānā rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyiṃsu.
dn27:11.13: nesaṃ rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyataṃ acchādesi, taṇhā ca tesaṃ okkami. candimasuriyādipātubhāvo
dn27:12.1: atha kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ hatthehi āluppakārakaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ.
dn27:12.2: yato kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ hatthehi āluppakārakaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ.
dn27:12.3: atha kho tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ sayampabhā antaradhāyi.
dn27:12.9: ettāvatā kho vāseṭṭhā, ayaṃ loko puna vivaṭṭo hoti.
dn27:13.1: atha kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:13.2: yathā yathā kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantānaṃ kharattañceva kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:13.3: ekidaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ekidaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:13.4: tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto, te dubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti.
dn27:13.6: tesaṃ vaṇṇātimānappaccayā mānātimānajātikānaṃ rasaṃ paṭhavī antaradhāyi.
dn27:13.12: tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anusaranti natvevassa atthaṃ ājānanti. bhūmipappaṭakapātubhāvo
dn27:14.1: atha kho tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ rasāya paṭhaviyā antarahitāya bhūmipappaṭako pāturahosi.
dn27:14.3: so ahosi vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno. seyyathāpi nāma sampannaṃ vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ evaṃvaṇṇo ahosi.
dn27:14.4: seyyathāpi nāma khuddamadhu aneḷakaṃ evamassādo ahosi.
dn27:14.5: atha kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā bhūmipappaṭakaṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ
dn27:14.6: te taṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:14.7: yathā yathā kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā bhūmipappaṭakaṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kharattañce va kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:14.8: ekidaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ekidaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:14.9: tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto, te dubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti
dn27:14.13: bhūmipappaṭake antarahite badālatā pāturahosi. seyyathāpi nāma kalambukā, evameva pāturahosi.
dn27:14.14: sā ahosi vaṇṇasampannā gandhasampannā rasasampannā. seyyathāpi nāma sampannaṃ vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ, evaṃvaṇṇā ahosi.
dn27:14.15: seyyathāpi nāma khuddamadhu aneḷakaṃ, evamassādā ahosi.
dn27:15.1: atha kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā badālataṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ
dn27:15.2: te taṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:15.3: yathā yathā kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā badālataṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kharattañceva kāyasmiṃ okkami vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha.
dn27:15.4: ekidaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ekidaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn27:15.5: tattha ye te sattā vaṇṇavanto, te dubbaṇṇe satte atimaññanti
dn27:15.9: ‘ahu vata no, ahāyi vata no badālatā’ti.
dn27:15.10: tadetarahipi manussā kenacideva dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhā evamāhaṃsu:
dn27:15.12: tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anusaranti, natvevassa atthaṃ ājānanti. akaṭṭhapākasālipātubhāvo
dn27:16.1: atha kho tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ badālatāya antarahitāya akaṭṭhapāko sāli pāturahosi akaṇo athuso suddho sugandho taṇḍulaphalo
dn27:16.2: yaṃ taṃ sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya āharanti. pāto taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ,
dn27:16.3: yaṃ taṃ pāto pātarāsāya āharanti, sāyaṃ taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ,
dn27:16.5: atha kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:16.7: yathā yathā kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kharattañceva kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha. itthiyā ca itthiliṅgaṃ pāturahosi, purisassa ca purisaliṅgaṃ.
dn27:16.8: itthi ca sudaṃ ‘purisaṃ ativelaṃ upanijjhāyati, puriso ca itthiṃ.
dn27:16.9: tesaṃ ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyataṃ sārāgo udapādi, pariḷāho kāyasmiṃ okkami.
dn27:16.11: ye kho pana te vāseṭṭhā tena samayena sattā passanti methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevante, aññe paṃsuṃ khipanti, aññe seṭṭhiṃ khipanti, aññe gomayaṃ khipanti
dn27:16.13: hi nāma satto sattassa evarūpaṃ karissatī’ti.
dn27:16.14: tadetarahi pi manussā ekaccesu janapadesu vadhuyā nibbuyahamānāya aññe paṃsuṃ khipanti, aññe seṭṭhiṃ khipanti, aññe gomayaṃ khipanti.
dn27:16.15: tadeva porāṇaṃ aggaññaṃ akkharaṃ anusaranti, natvevassa atthaṃ ājānanti. methunadhammasamācāro
dn27:17.1: adhammasammataṃ kho pana vāseṭṭhā, yaṃ tena samayena hoti, tadetarahi dhammasammataṃ.
dn27:17.2: ye kho pana vāseṭṭhā tena samayena sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti, temāsampi dvemāsampi na labhanti gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisituṃ.
dn27:17.3: yato kho pana te vāseṭṭhā sattā tasmiṃ samaye asaddhamme ativelaṃ pātabyataṃ āpajjiṃsu,
dn27:17.4: atha kho agārāni upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, tasseva asaddhammassa paṭicchādanatthaṃ.
dn27:17.5: atha kho vāseṭṭhā, aññatarassa sattassa alasajātikassa etadahosi:
dn27:17.6: “ambho kimevāhaṃ vihaññāmi sāliṃ āharanto sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya?
dn27:17.8: atha kho so vāseṭṭhā, satto sāliṃ āhāsi sakideva sāyapātarāsāya.
dn27:17.9: atha kho vāseṭṭhā, aññataro satto yena so satto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sattaṃ etadavoca:
dn27:17.11: “alaṃ bho satta āhaṭo me sāli sakideva sāyapātarāsāyā”ti.
dn27:17.12: atha kho so vāseṭṭhā satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakideva dvīhāya. ‘evampi kira bho sādhū’ti.
dn27:17.13: atha kho vāseṭṭhā aññataro satto yena so satto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sattaṃ etadavoca:
dn27:17.15: “alaṃ bho satta āhaṭo me sāli sakideva dvīhāyā”ti.
dn27:17.16: atha kho so vāseṭṭhā, satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakideva catūhāya, ‘evampi kira bho sādhū’ti.
dn27:17.20: atha kho so vāseṭṭhā, satto tassa sattassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi sakideva aṭṭhāhāya, ‘evampi kira bho sādhū’ti.
dn27:17.21: yato kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā sannidhikārakaṃ sāliṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ,
dn27:17.22: atha kaṇo pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonaddhi, thuso pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonaddhi,
dn27:17.23: lūnampi nappaṭivirūḷhaṃ apadānaṃ paññāyittha, saṇḍasaṇḍā sālayo aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn27:18.1: atha kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā sannipatiṃsu, sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu,
dn27:18.3: mayaṃ hi pubbe manomayā ahumha pītibhakkhā sayampabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamha
dn27:18.4: tesaṃ no amhākaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena rasā paṭhavī udakasmiṃ samatāni.
dn27:18.6: te mayaṃ rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ hatthehi āluppakārakaṃ upakkamimha paribhuñjituṃ, tesaṃ no rasapaṭhaviṃ hatthehi āluppakārakaṃ upakkamataṃ paribhuñjituṃ sayampabhā antaradhāyi.
dn27:18.7: tāya antarahitāya candimasuriyā pāturahesuṃ. candimasuriyesu pātubhūtesu nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni pāturahesuṃ, nakkhattesu tārakarūpesu pātubhūtesu rattindivā paññāyiṃsu. rattindivesu paññāyamānesu māsaddhamāsā paññāyiṃsu.
dn27:18.9: te mayaṃ rasaṃ paṭhaviṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamha.
dn27:18.10: tesaṃ no pāpakānaññeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā rasā paṭhavī antaradhāyi.
dn27:18.14: te mayaṃ taṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamha.
dn27:18.15: tesaṃ no pāpakānaññeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā bhūmipappaṭake antaradhāyi.
dn27:18.19: te mayaṃ taṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamha.
dn27:18.20: tesaṃ no pāpakānaññeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā badālatā antaradhāyi.
dn27:18.21: badālatāya antarahitāya akaṭṭhapāko sāli pāturahosi, akaṇo athuso suddho sugandho taṇḍulaphalo.
dn27:18.22: yaṃ taṃ sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya āharāma, pāto taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ.
dn27:18.23: yaṃ taṃ pāto pātarāsāya āharāma, sāyantaṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ.
dn27:18.25: te mayaṃ akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāḷiṃ paribhuñjantā tambhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ aṭṭhamha.
dn27:18.26: tesaṃ no pāpakānañceva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā kaṇo pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonaddhi, thuso pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonaddhi, lūnampi nappaṭivirūḷhaṃ, apadānaṃ paññāyittha, saṇḍasaṇḍā sālayo ṭhitā.
dn27:18.27: yannūna mayaṃ sāliṃ vibhajeyyāma, mariyādaṃ ṭhapeyyāmā’ti.
dn27:18.28: atha kho te vāseṭṭha, sattā sāliṃ vibhajiṃsu, mariyādaṃ ṭhapesuṃ.
dn27:19.1: atha kho vāseṭṭhā aññataro satto lolajātiko sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji.
dn27:19.3: ‘pāpakaṃ vata bho satta karosi, yatra hi nāma sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñjissasi.
dn27:19.5: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho vāseṭṭhā, so satto tesaṃ sattānaṃ paccassosi.
dn27:19.6: dutiyampi kho vāseṭṭhā, so satto sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji. tamenaṃ aggahesuṃ, gahetvā etadavocuṃ: ‘pāpakaṃ vata bho satta karosi, yatra hi nāma sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñjissi. māssu bho satta punapi evarūpamakāsī’ti.
dn27:19.7: tatiyampi kho vāseṭṭhā, so satto sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñji.
dn27:19.9: pāpakaṃ vata bho satta karosi, yatra hi nāma sakaṃ bhāgaṃ parirakkhanto aññataraṃ bhāgaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyitvā paribhuñjissasi.
dn27:19.11: aññe pāṇinā pahariṃsu, aññe leḍḍunā pahariṃsu, aññe daṇḍena pahariṃsu.
dn27:19.12: tadagge kho pana vāseṭṭhā, adinnādānaṃ paññāyati, garahā paññāyati, musāvādo paññāyati, daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyati.
dn27:20.1: atha kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā sannipatiṃsu, sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu
dn27:20.2: “pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātubhūtā, yatra hi nāma adinnādānaṃ paññāyissati, garahā paññāyissati, musāvādo paññāyissati, daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyissati.
dn27:20.3: yannūna mayaṃ ekaṃ sattaṃ sammanneyyāma, yo no sammā khīyitabbaṃ khīyeyya, sammā garahitabbaṃ garaheyya, sammā pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājeyya.
dn27:20.5: atha kho te vāseṭṭhā, sattā yo nesaṃ satto abhirūpataro ca dassanīyataro ca pāsādikataro ca mahesakkhataro ca, taṃ sattaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ:
dn27:20.6: ehi bho satta, sammā khīyitabbaṃ khīya, sammā garahitabbaṃ garaha, sammā pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājehi.
dn27:20.7: mayaṃ pana te sālīnaṃ bhāgaṃ anuppadassāmā”ti.
dn27:20.8: ‘evaṃ bho’ti kho vāseṭṭhā so satto tesaṃ sattānaṃ paṭissuṇitvā, sammā khīyitabbaṃ khīyi, sammā garahitabbaṃ garahi, sammā pabbājetabbaṃ pabbājesi.
dn27:21.1: mahājanasammato’ti kho vāseṭṭhā ‘mahāsammato mahāsammato’tveva paṭhamaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.2: khettānaṃ adhipatīti kho vāseṭṭhā, ‘khattiyo khattiyo’tveva dutiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.3: dhammena pare rañjetīti kho vāseṭṭhā, ‘rājā, rājā’tveva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:21.4: iti kho vāseṭṭhā, evametassa khattiyamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi. te saññeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ, sadisānaññeva no asadisānaṃ. dhammeneva, no adhammena.
dn27:21.5: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho jane’tasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca. brāhmaṇamaṇḍalaṃ
dn27:22.1: atha kho tesaṃ vāseṭṭhā, sattānaññeva ekaccānaṃ etadahosi:
dn27:22.2: pāpakā vata bho dhammā sattesu pātubhūtā, yatra hi nāma adinnādānaṃ paññāyissati, garahā paññāyissati, musāvādo paññāyissati, daṇḍādānaṃ paññāyissati, pabbājanaṃ paññāyissati.
dn27:22.3: yannūna mayaṃ pāpake akusale dhamme vāheyyāmā”ti.
dn27:22.5: pāpake akusale dhamme bāhentīti kho vāseṭṭhā, ‘brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇā’tveva paṭhamaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:22.6: te araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭiyo karitvā paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti, vītaṅgārā vītadhūmā pannamusalā sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya gāmanigamarājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsamesānā
dn27:22.7: te ghāsaṃ paṭilabhitvā punadeva araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti.
dn27:22.9: ‘ime kho bho sattā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭiyo karitvā paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti, vitaṅgārā vītadhūmā pannamusalā sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya gāmanigamarājadhāniyo osaranti ghāsamesānā.
dn27:22.10: te ghāsaṃ paṭilabhitvā punadeva araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu jhāyanti
dn27:22.11: jhāyantīti kho pana vāseṭṭhā, ‘jhāyakā jhāyakā’tveva dutiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:23.1: tesaññeva kho vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ ekacce sattā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu taṃ jhānaṃ anabhisambhuṇamānā gāmasāmantaṃ nigamasāmantaṃ osaritvā ganthe karonto acchanti.
dn27:23.3: ime kho bho sattā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu taṃ jhānaṃ anabhisambhuṇamānā gāmasāmantaṃ nigamasāmantaṃ osaritvā ganthe karontā acchanti! na’dāni me jhāyanti, na’dāni
dn27:23.4: me jhāyantī ti kho vāseṭṭhā, ‘ajjhāyakā ajjhāyakā’tveva tatiyaṃ akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:23.5: hīnasammataṃ kho pana vāseṭṭhā, yaṃ tena samayena hoti, tadetarahi seṭṭhasammataṃ.
dn27:23.6: iti kho vāseṭṭhā, evametassa brāhmaṇamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi. tesaññeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ, sadisānaññeva no asadisānaṃ, dhammeneva, no adhammena.
dn27:23.7: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā, seṭṭho jane’tasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca. vessamaṇḍalaṃ tesaññeva
dn27:24.1: kho vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ ekacce sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vissutaṃ kammante payojesuṃ.
dn27:24.2: methunaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vissutaṃ kammante peyājentīti kho vāseṭṭhā, vessā vessātveva akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:24.3: iti kho vāseṭṭhā, evametassa vessamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi, tesaññeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ sadisānaññeva no asadisānaṃ dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:24.4: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā, seṭṭho jane’tasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca. suddamaṇḍalaṃ
dn27:25.1: tesaññeva kho vāseṭṭhā, sattānaṃ ye te sattā avasesā te ḷuddācārā khuddācārā ahesuṃ.
dn27:25.2: ḷuddācārā khuddācārāti kho vāseṭṭhā, suddā suddātveva akkharaṃ upanibbattaṃ.
dn27:25.3: iti kho vāseṭṭhā, evametassa suddamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi. tesaññeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ, sadisānaññeva no asadisānaṃ, dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:25.4: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā, seṭṭho jane’tasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca.
dn27:26.1: ahu kho so vāseṭṭhā, samayo yaṃ khattiyo pi sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati,
dn27:26.3: brāhmaṇopi kho vāseṭṭhā sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, ‘samaṇo bhavissāmī’ti,
dn27:26.4: vessopi kho vāseṭṭhā sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, ‘samaṇo bhavissāmī’ti,
dn27:26.5: suddopi kho vāseṭṭhā, sakaṃ dhammaṃ garahamāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati
dn27:26.7: imehi kho vāseṭṭhā, catūhi maṇḍalehi samaṇamaṇḍalassa abhinibbatti ahosi. tesaññeva sattānaṃ anaññesaṃ, sadisānaññeva no asadisānaṃ, dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:26.8: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā, seṭṭho jane’tasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca.
dn27:27.1: khattiyo pi kho vāseṭṭhā, kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā, micchādiṭṭhiko, micchādiṭṭhikammasamādāno micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:27.5: …pe… samaṇo pi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā, micchādiṭṭhiko micchādiṭṭhikammasamādāno micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:28.1: khattiyopi kho vāseṭṭhā, kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā, manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā, sammādiṭṭhiko sammādiṭṭhikammasamādāno sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:28.5: …pe… samaṇo pi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā …pe… saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
dn27:29.1: khattiyo pi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena dvayakārī, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī, vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissadiṭṭhikammasamādāno vimissadiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī hoti.
dn27:29.5: …pe… samaṇo pi kho vāseṭṭhā kāyena dvayakārī, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī, vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissadiṭṭhikammasamādāno vimissadiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī hoti.
dn27:30.1: khattiyo pi kho vāseṭṭhā, kāyena saṃvuto, vācāya saṃvuto, manasā saṃvuto, sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanamanvāya diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāti. brāhmaṇo
dn27:30.5: samaṇo pi kho vāseṭṭhā, kāyena saṃvuto, vācāya saṃvuto, manasā saṃvuto, sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanamanvāya diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāti. imesaṃ
dn27:31.1: hi vāseṭṭhā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimutto, so nesaṃ aggamakkhāyati. dhammeneva no adhammena.
dn27:31.2: dhammo hi vāseṭṭhā seṭṭho jane’tasmiṃ diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyeca.
dn27:32.1: brahmunā pi vāseṭṭhā sanaṅkumārena gāthā bhāsitā:
dn27:32.6: sā kho panesā vāseṭṭhā gāthā brahmunā sanaṅkumārena sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā mayā,
